description: This file defines a PHP class 'CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI' within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, used for marking a candidate interview as passed via an API endpoint. It includes validation rules, OpenAPI documentation annotations, and references external entity classes.

classes.name: CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI
classes.description: A PHP API class for marking a candidate interview as passed, extending the abstract candidate action API. It provides validation rules and specifies the resulting workflow state.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to add validation rules for the interview ID parameter, ensuring it is positive and exists in the Interview entity.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the integer constant representing the workflow state for a passed interview.
